schema_note: Field order in this artifact is NORMATIVE (deterministic field order; reviewers diff artifacts textually). A change to ANY field — an added, removed, or re-parameterised window, a new baseline version, a changed registered threshold — is a NEW version id (forecast-eval-set-v2, ...), frozen as a NEW file. This file is never edited in place after freeze (the P8.19 anti-silent-growth rule, mirrored).
mirrors: benchmarks/research-set-v1.json (P8.19 shape; the anti-silent-growth and run-status disciplines carry over verbatim)
units: MW, MVAr, MVA, MWh (report §10.2 canonical). P > 0 means export at the point of connection. Load series carry the caller's declared sign convention (consumption negative in the fixture convention), never normalized. Prices, when a future version evaluates price series, carry a DECLARED currency per MWh.
anti_silent_growth_rule: An eval-set change is a NEW version. This mirrors the P8.06 frozen-baseline discipline (a baseline change is a new baseline version, never a silent edit) and the P8.19 benchmark-set rule. Every forecast evaluation that reports numbers on windows in this set cites exactly ONE version id — this one for the v1 freezes. An evaluation whose cited version differs from the artifact it claims to use is a named finding, never absorbed.
run_status_note: NOTHING in this set has been RUN. The platform has never executed (no runtime data exists — the recorded Phase-15 constraint), so every evaluation cell is EMPTY by construction. Every run_status below is NOT_RUN, every observed_value is null, and no skill is claimed for any model. The human/lab build-and-run gate produces run evidence in evaluation records that cite this version id and carry a gate authorization — a filled run never edits this artifact.
adr_010_note: Every evaluation result is a RECORD about forecast quality (an input, record, or proposal — program conventions 6.3). No evaluation result, score, or skill claim may construct or influence a dispatch command — structural, not conventional. No market/conformance claim rides any result.

baseline_registry.reference_baseline: forecast-baseline/persistence (skill = beating this on a frozen window; until an evaluation run exists, NO model — this one included — claims skill)

baselines.rule: forecast(t) = last observed value, carried forward unchanged for every horizon step
forecast(t) = the value exactly one declared season earlier; longer horizons wrap within the last season
OLS of load on (intercept, HDD, CDD); deterministic Gaussian elimination, first-max pivoting; degree days are DECLARED inputs (P15.03 seam, P15-E-1 OPEN)

metric_vocabulary.note: The X-8 pre-registration discipline: metric NAMES and threshold BOUNDS are registered here BEFORE any run that could fill them; OBSERVED values live structurally separate (an EvaluationRunRecord cannot be constructed inside the program — the run-gate type has no public constructor; crates/flexcore-application/src/forecast_evaluation.rs). A filled run never edits this artifact.

metrics.registered_bound_note: PLACEHOLDER-FREEZE DEFAULT: 0.0 means 'no threshold registered yet' (a bound of 0.0 MW is unachievable by construction, so it can never be silently met). Replacing it with a real bound is a NEW set version, registered BEFORE any run — never an in-place edit, never a post-hoc fit.
PLACEHOLDER-FREEZE DEFAULT: 0.0 means 'no threshold registered yet'. Replacing it is a NEW set version, registered BEFORE any run.

metrics.definition: 1 - MAE_model / MAE_persistence on the same window; defined only for a strictly positive persistence MAE
metrics.registered_bound_note: PLACEHOLDER-FREEZE DEFAULT: 0.0 means 'no threshold registered yet' (a skill score of exactly 0.0 would mean the model exactly ties persistence — a real threshold, when registered, will state the minimum skill a run must show to count, BEFORE the run).

backtesting_protocol.frozen_split_rule: a forecaster is scored only on test windows it did not see; a test window that overlaps or precedes its train window is refused (BacktestWindowError::TestOverlapsTrain, crates/flexcore-application/src/forecast_evaluation.rs)

windows.source_data: scenarios/synthetic-portfolio/forecast-fixture-v1.json (v1; SYNTHETIC — the P3.31 fixture; no runtime data exists)
windows.note: day 2 of the fixture horizon as the test window (start-inclusive, end-exclusive, UTC millis); SYNTHETIC data only — a window over real data enters as a NEW set version after the platform has run

model_evaluation_cells.note: One cell per (model, window, metric). Every cell is EMPTY: observed_value null, run_status NOT_RUN. A filled cell lives in an evaluation RECORD that cites this version id and a gate authorization — never here.

designed_untrained_models.note: The models DESIGNED in this phase that no evaluation row may reference until they are trained AND evaluated (P15.03/P15.06): every designed model registers UNTRAINED (a first-class registered state); no skill is claimed anywhere.

models.weather_data_status: P15-E-1 OPEN — no vendor integration; the weather port has no implementation (UNSIGNED gate)

models.training_data_status: no training run is claimed; data enters only through the P15.18 datasets policy (no production telemetry in simulation)

permission_and_authority_note: The forecast producer permission vocabulary is telemetry.read + forecast.publish (plugins/manifests/forecast-worker.manifest.json classes; no dispatch permission). The never-granted permission set — dispatch.authorize, dispatch.issue, secret.read, network.any — stays byte-identical (crates/flexcore-kernel/src/manifest.rs::NEVER_GRANTED_PERMISSIONS).

evaluation_citations.rule: Every forecast evaluation that reports numbers on windows in this set cites version_id forecast-eval-set-v1 on every row, plus the gate authorization reference of the human/lab run. An evaluation row without the version id or the gate authorization is invalid and must not be entered.

expected_citing_records.P15.05_evaluation: docs/phases-11-20/phase-15-forecasting-asset-intelligence/records/05_p15_05_forecast_evaluation.md — the framework record (cells EMPTY in this delivery; the run record does not exist until the first human/lab run)
expected_citing_records.P15.16_forecast_to_schedule: the staleness/fallback integration consumes evaluated baselines only; until an evaluation fills a cell, the P3.31 fixture stays the labeled synthetic fallback source
expected_citing_records.P16_mv_and_bids: Phase 16 consumes forecasts and evaluation records; nothing in Phase 15 bids (ADR-011 boundary unchanged)

growth_path: A new window (e.g. one over runtime data once the platform has run), a new metric, a new model row, or a real registered threshold enters ONLY as a NEW version (forecast-eval-set-v2) frozen as a new artifact — never by editing this file. No candidate is silently promoted.
